title: Freiburg Brain Immune Data Viewer: a serverless browser for published single-cell and spatial datasets
description:
A pipeline that converts collections of Seurat and RaceID objects into cloud-optimised AnnData-Zarr stores and generates a static Vitessce viewer over them, so published single-cell and spatial datasets can be browsed from a static file host with no backend server.

Expression is stored as a dense array chunked along the gene axis, so colouring an embedding by any gene is a single chunk read. Every conversion is verified against its source object before it is accepted, metadata columns are shown under harmonised names, and the pipeline ships an end-to-end self-test on synthetic data (bash scripts/selftest.sh).

This release accompanies the Application Note describing the tool and was applied to 53 datasets from 16 publications (1,342,207 cells; scRNA-seq, snRNA-seq, CITE-seq, scATAC-seq, Nanostring CosMx and Visium HD, in human, mouse and Drosophila). The archive contains the code, view configurations and static site; the converted data stores are served separately.
